class: A rule that picks a page's first tab from 'did the read succeed' treats a failed read as 'the user has positions', so a user with no broker connection lands on an empty Positions tab.
mechanism: The positions page opened on Positions whenever its read ended, whatever the reason.

first_seen.evidence: Paper tab was second and Positions selected, showing 'Connect your Zerodha account to continue.' Re-proof on the new head: Paper tab selected; with ?tab=positions the Positions tab is selected.

fix: A not-connected user with an open paper strategy opens on Paper; other read failures stay on Positions (38abea1e).

detection.note: Pinned for the not-connected case. Open: broker state 'partial' with a real server error also opens on Paper (Sonnet review MINOR).
